What's Inside the Pack

Module 1: Complete Architecture & Core Playbook

03_Advanced_Workflows_and_Automations.md * Next.js 15 Server Action & Route Handler Blueprints: Type-safe dispatch scripts using the Resend SDK with edge runtime compatibility. * Resend Inbound Webhook Handlers: Production-ready API route handlers that ingest bounce, delivery, and complaint webhooks to update your database instantly. * Automated Suppression Queues: Zero-maintenance logic to auto-suppress hard bounces and spam complaints before they damage your sender score. * Idempotency & Concurrency Guards: Redis and Upstash-backed idempotency layers to prevent double-charging or duplicate email dispatch during network retries.
